Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted window tinting network. We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years. Here is why home window tinting is worth it and what makes ours the best home window tint:

Is Home Window Tinting Worth It?

When you consider all the benefits of having window tint installed in your home, is home window tinting worth it? Absolutely! Benefits of home window tinting include:

  • Flooring & furnishings are protected from premature fading, wear & tear
  • You and your family are protected from the damage caused by harmful UV rays
  • Heat is reduced during summer months and retained during cooler months for more comfortable temperatures all year round (you’ll save on your power bill too)
  • A reduction in glare helps to prevent reflections on screens
  • Privacy
  • Peace of mind knowing your family and valuables are safe

What Makes Ours The Best Home Window Tint?
